items.prompt: What would be missing from a claim that one function is production-fast because its best tiny benchmark repeat was quick?
items.modelAnswer: The contract/correctness comparison, workload sizes/distributions, preprocessing/I/O, environment, concurrency and latency distribution are missing. Separate microbenchmark evidence from production requirements.

criteria.text: Distinguishes a best repeat from production tail behavior.
